integrity: Finite verification uses explicit enumeration of all ninety source words, their one-deletion shadows, all equality selections induced by an eighteen-output transversal, and every maximal clique. The proof has not undergone independent audit.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns only six-symbol ternary strings of composition (2,2,2). It does not imply analogous values for other lengths, alphabets, or compositions. The full text of a directly relevant historical thesis was unavailable for source comparison.
title: Exact balanced ternary deletion codes and a chromatic obstruction
